powerpuffGeneration.source:
Generated images are saved to $HOME/.codex/generated_images/01a0dd49-bdf9-76e0-bc51-822e9402c9cc as $HOME/.codex/generated_images/01a0dd49-bdf9-76e0-bc51-822e9402c9cc/exec-072e9d24-0af8-49e1-91ff-0b789d5dbfb3.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.

packing: Native Electron codec for grid unpacking and atlas compilation; authored poses retained; common scale and stationary foot registration; no raster warping
limitations: 16 authored key poses per style; not continuous skeletal animation
Available: idle, blink, talk, wave, nod, sleep, happy, thinking, sleepy
Shake, bounce, sad and surprised were not authored for these packs
Low-poly 3D style is a PNG sequence, not a rigged 3D mesh
pixelPalette: 32 deliberately selected pink, blue, purple, skin, white, gold and outline colors; not most-frequent RGB values
